Page No.# 2/3 Apprehending arrest, in connection with Changsari P.S. Case No.88/2023, under Sections 420/468/471/379 IPC, this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. is preferred by the applicant, namely, Washim Rahman for grant of pre-arrest bail.

sentences.text:
The essence of allegation made in the FIR dated 22.3.2023 that on 3.3.2023, Barua Logistics, a transportation Company, dealing with transportation in North East India, has transported one Kia Seltos Car, bearing No. AS-33-3151 from Dibrugarh to Changsari on behalf of one Abhisek Kumar,
then one person namely, Wasim Rahman, saying that he is an employee of Abhisek Kumar, received the vehicle from the aforesaid transport Company and thereafter, on 4.5.2023, he has transferred the car in the name of his wife, namely, Ms. Monowara Begum.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that this Court was pleased to extend the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail, vide order dated 10.5.2023, and pursuant to said order, he had appeared before the I.O. and he is cooperating with the investigating agency and therefore, it is contended to make the interim order dated 10.5.2023 absolute in the same terms and condition.

On the other hand, Mr. K. K. Parasar, learned Addl. P.P. submits that he has not received the case diary, but, as per instruction received by him, the I.O. has completed investigation and submitted charge sheet being charge sheet, No. 172 of 2023, dated 31.7.2023, u/s 420 /468 /471/ 379 IPC against the present applicant.

In view of above, it is provided that the applicant shall appear, on or before 1.12.2023, before the learned Court below and apply for regular bail and in the event of filing such an application, the learned Court below shall consider Page No.# 3/3 the same in accordance with law.
Till then, interim order dated 10.5.2023 stands extended.
